data.one_liner: Type‑safe Dart API for reading, writing and monitoring the Windows clipboard.
data.what_it_does: Provides high‑level functions to get/set text, file lists and custom data on the Windows clipboard. Includes a stream‑based monitor for clipboard change notifications, all built on top of win32 FFI.
use_when: You need clipboard access in a Windows‑only Flutter or Dart desktop app
You want a type‑safe, high‑level API without handling raw Win32 calls
You need real‑time clipboard change notifications
avoid_when: Your app targets iOS, Android, Web or other non‑Windows platforms
You prefer a pure‑Dart solution without native dependencies
strengths: Type‑safe, high‑level abstraction over Win32 clipboard
Stream‑based change monitoring without blocking the main isolate
Supports text, file lists and custom formats
weaknesses: Requires win32 FFI and native build steps
